name: Creating and Updating Brands & NOs (For Finance Reasons)
trigger: A new Brand or Network Operator is added, or an existing one's billing information must change.
purpose: How Brands (QuickBooks Customers) and NOs (QuickBooks Vendors) get created and maintained via Portal and the AP team. Portal holds partial data at creation; AP fills in the rest from Ops emails. Portal is not yet the source of truth for QB data, so this document is until Engineering ships the Portal ↔ QB sync.
doneWhen: The QuickBooks Customer or Vendor record carries complete, accurate billing information that matches Portal.

steps.title: New record, or an update?
steps.trigger: A Brand or NO needs a QuickBooks change.
steps.work: Decide whether this is a brand-new Brand or NO, or a change to an existing one's fields.

steps.title: Create the Brand or NO in Portal
steps.trigger: A new Brand or NO is being onboarded.
steps.work: Create the Brand or NO in Portal with whatever information is available. Partial information is expected and acceptable.

steps.title: Automation creates the QuickBooks record
steps.trigger: A Brand or NO is created in Portal.
steps.work: Engineering's automation creates the matching QB Customer (for a Brand) or Vendor (for an NO). No Ops action. QB records are always created by automation, never by hand; if one is missing, escalate to Eng.
rules: Never create a QB Customer or Vendor manually.

steps.title: Gather the Brand's billing details
steps.trigger: The QB Customer exists but is incomplete.
steps.work: Collect from the Brand: legal business name, business address, and billing contact name, email and phone.

steps.title: Gather the NO's billing details, W9 and ACH
steps.trigger: The QB Vendor exists but is incomplete.
steps.work: Collect from the NO: business name (must match the W9), business address, billing contact name, email and phone, the W9, and ACH information. Do not store ACH details in Portal.
rules: Never store ACH details in Portal.
Send W9s and ACH info only to ap@.

steps.title: Email the details to AP
steps.work: Email ap@getthom.com with the collected information, including the W9 and ACH details for an NO. Forgetting this step leaves the QB record incomplete.

steps.title: Email AP the update request
steps.trigger: An existing Brand's or NO's information changed.
steps.work: Email ap@getthom.com specifying the field(s) and new value(s). Updating Portal alone does nothing; QB will not follow in the current state.

steps.title: AP updates the QuickBooks record
steps.trigger: An email from Ops arrives at ap@.
steps.work: AP manually updates the QB Customer or Vendor record with the supplied information.

steps.title: Does the W9 name match the Vendor name?
steps.trigger: An NO record was updated with a W9.
steps.work: For NOs, compare the business name on the W9 with the Vendor name in QB. For Brands this check does not apply.

steps.title: Fix the name in QB and Portal
steps.trigger: The W9 name does not match the QB Vendor name.
steps.work: AP updates the QB Vendor name to match the W9 and emails Ops to update Portal accordingly.
